authority: Complete canonical EFZ PE 3,528-byte Kanna virtual Slot02 owner exactly regenerated by natural VC7.1 C++
method: Selected VC7.1 /Od /G6 /MT /Gy /W3 COFF compilation and strict byte-for-byte comparison of the complete native function. No relocations, ASM, byte edits, code padding, or whole-product replay.
behavior: Twelve ordered circular 180-frame input-history recognizers, preserving original command priority, facing-dependent direction tests, attack-button combinations, and the 1000-meter super-command gate.
source_findings: The original native code scans the history in a strict priority order: long 100-meter command, four special-move scans, release-edge detector, four button-specific command scans, and two short down/up scans. The mutually exclusive one-byte scan stage and release-edge flag are modeled as a real C++ union; this gives the original single stack slot and exact native bytes.
